title: S4-FX-04 — One normal exports; two refuse; lighting Cancel preserves layers.
goal: With exactly one surface (normal) layer the Godot kit's normal atlas is ready; a lighting preview cancelled leaves both layers and the artwork exact; with a second surface layer the normal atlas is refused with its reason.

steps.text: Normal maps: Verified neutral normal layer on all 1 frames.
steps.why: Exactly one normal source is accepted.
Cancelling the lighting preview keeps both layers and the artwork exact.
The Layers panel lists three layers: the second surface layer is still there.
Duplicating the surface layer makes a second normal source.
The export dialog keeps the normal atlas setting.
Two normal sources in one frame are refused in the preflight.

steps.alert: Normal export needs exactly one full-opacity Normal Facets or Normal Map layer
steps.why: The download is refused with the reason; no kit is written.
The Layers panel lists three layers: the second surface layer is still there.

cliOnly: opening the ZIP and decoding its 18 x 18 normal atlas: the neutral field inside a transparent one-pixel border (scripts/testsprite/pixibun-explicit-normal-sources-integrity.py, tests/production/gameDelivery.spec.ts)
